stages.title: Desktop test alignment
stages.description: Manual MetroMap activation, current inspector collapse levels and guarded desktop release selection.

stages.title: Canonical receipt eligibility
stages.description: Draft deposits remain allowed. Ordinary payments require Issued or Accepted; Declined blocks new receipts.

stages.title: Workspace review and owner decisions
stages.description: 54 sample warnings corrected in a separate candidate. All three owner decisions closed: sample budgets do not apply to the clean release; automation stays paused.

stages.title: Dependency assessment
stages.description: Inventory and isolated PDF.js 6.4.299 compatibility proposal retained. Shipped runtimes unchanged; dependency risks remain open.

stages.title: Governance, officers and CSS
stages.description: Explicit-calendar contracts, named officers for new reversals, paused clean defaults, bounded inspector CSS consolidation and final reports.

findings.title: Stale release checks
findings.label: Remediated
findings.detail: Desktop selection and guarded tests match the current manual-key and inspector workflows. Screenshot/mobile aggregates remain excluded.

findings.title: Receipt command eligibility
findings.label: Remediated
findings.detail: The command and UI agree on deposits, ordinary payments and Declined Quotes. Historical receipts and reversals remain accessible.

findings.title: Historical sample warnings
findings.label: Owner decisions closed
findings.detail: Two absent sample budgets are irrelevant to a release with no saved workspace. No amounts were invented. The owner confirmed automation must stay paused; historical sample warnings remain truthful.

findings.title: Automatic Job governance drift
findings.label: Remediated
findings.detail: Active contracts now require the explicit Planner calendar action. Purpose changes and normal saves affect eligibility without creating or recreating Jobs. Historical rules are retained as superseded.

findings.title: Vendored dependency risks
findings.label: Open vendor update
findings.detail: MapLibre 5.3.0 matches critical GHSA-jrc7-96c5-q579. Current attribution is curated, but the affected library still ships. PDF.js 2.16.105 retains its explicit isEvalSupported:false mitigation. Full local licence texts and a separately verified vendor upgrade remain outstanding.

findings.title: Inspector CSS duplication
findings.label: Remediated
findings.detail: Consolidated proven duplicate declarations and removed an overridden action-row rule. Existing 8px tokens replace equivalent literals; both owner themes and all three collapse levels were checked using computed styles.

findings.title: Payment reversal officer
findings.label: Remediated
findings.detail: New reversals require a trimmed officer name and reason in the UI and canonical command. Session names prefill an editable field. Evidence survives reload; old missing actors remain missing and repeated commands preserve the first evidence.

findings.title: Release environment verification
findings.label: Not verified
findings.detail: These are local desktop Chromium HTTP checks. GitHub Pages, Edge file:// and the broader PDF corpus are not certified. A clean client handover requires fresh or deliberately cleared browser storage; this work does not erase an existing operator workspace.
